recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, intimate close-up portrait of a couple in soft, natural light, characterized by a warm 1960s analog film aesthetic and vertically stacked, outlined sans-serif typography positioned in the upper-left quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: The man's direct gaze creates a connection with the viewer while the woman's profile gaze creates internal narrative depth.
The vertical stack of text balances the heavy visual weight of the subjects on the right.
Warm skin tones contrast against the cool, muted olive and blue tones of the clothing.
coreInvariants: Visible film grain and slight color shift towards yellow/green in highlights
Tight cropping that cuts off the top of the subjects' heads

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects occupy the right two-thirds of the frame in a large-scale close-up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The man's eyes serve as the primary focal point, centered horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the man's eyes, moves down to the woman's profile, then sweeps left to the vertical text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Limited negative space in the upper-left corner, used for typographic placement.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Muted olive green (jacket) and pale blue (turtleneck)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with mid-range values; shadows are deep but retain detail.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones and desaturated blues

letterConstructionRules: Strict vertical alignment to the left margin
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for all display text to maintain a clean, modernist look against the organic photo.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed structure.
Matches the 1960s modernist aesthetic of the era.
Offers the right balance of vintage feel and readability.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a warm, grainy 1960s film-style portrait of a Black man and woman in an intimate embrace. The man looks forward, the woman looks up at him in profile. Use soft natural lighting, muted olive and blue clothing, and a blurred outdoor background. Leave the upper-left corner relatively clear.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add vertically stacked text in the upper-left corner using a bold condensed sans-serif font. The text should have a thin white outline and no fill. Align all lines to the left.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette muted and warm?
Is the grain texture consistent with 60s film?
Is the text stacked vertically word-by-word?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text fill is present.
Check that the man's gaze is direct.
Verify the vertical alignment of the text block.
Confirm the background is sufficiently blurred.
recipe.reuseFormula: Intimate vintage portrait + vertical outline typography + muted 60s color grade.
